blocks.title: Damped oscillations
blocks.text: Woh oscillations jin ka amplitude mazahmati quwwaton ki wajah se ghatta hai damped oscillations kehlati hain, aur mazahmati quwwatein damping forces kehlati hain.

Misali free oscillation mein kul mechanical tawanai constant rehti hai, jaise mass-spring nizam, daire mein ghoomta jism aur simple pendulum. Amalan hawa ki mazahmat aur ragar jaisi tawanai zaya karne wali quwwatein amal karti hain, is liye amplitude waqt ke saath ahista ahista ghatta aur jism aakhir ruk jata hai. Maslan jhoole par larki chhote se chhote amplitude se jhoolti aur aakhir ruk jati hai (Fig 14.14, kitab mein khaaka); damped oscillation graph par Fig 14.15 mein dikhayi gayi hai. Ahista ruka pendulum, aur ungli se chhua thartharata tuning fork bhi misalein hain.

blocks.alt: Jhoole par bethi larki ke do lamhe, koi dhakka nahi de raha: jhoola khud aage peeche jhoolta aur ahista ahista ruk jata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 14.14: Jhoole ki damped oscillation (kitab ki Figure 14.14 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: O se waqt ke muqable displacement. Curve time axis ke gird jhoolta hai aur har jhool pichhli se chhoti hai; oopar neeche do dashed curves tang hota ghera (envelope) banate hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 14.15: Damped oscillation ka graph (kitab ki Figure 14.15 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

items: Halki damping: tawanai aur amplitude ahista ahista ghatte hain; jism rukne se pehle kai dafa jhoolta hai. Khel ke maidan ka jhoola achhi misal hai.
Bhari damping: jism jhoolta nahi aur rest tak wapas aane mein der lagata hai, maslan garhe tel mein pendulum.
Critical damping: jism jhoole baghair kam se kam waqt mein apni tawazun ki jagah par wapas aa jata hai, maslan gari ke shock absorbers.

blocks.alt: Teen curves aik hi displacement se shuru: halki damping (light) ka neela curve O ke gird jhoolta hai aur amplitude ahista ghatta hai; critical damping ka hara curve sab se jaldi O par pahunchta hai aur paar nahi jata; bhari damping (heavy) ka surkh curve bohat ahista O ki taraf aata hai.
blocks.caption: Halki, critical aur bhari damping (asal graph; kitab mein yeh figure nahi).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Teenon jism aik hi jagah se chhore gaye hain. Halki damping mein jism kai dafa jhoolta hai. Critical damping mein woh baghair jhoole sab se kam waqt mein O par aa jata hai, is liye gari ke shock absorbers isi ke qareeb banaye jate hain. Bhari damping mein bhi jhoolna nahi hota, lekin wapsi bohat ahista hoti hai, jaise gaarhe tel (thick oil) mein pendulum.

Gari ke suspension nizam ke shock absorbers damping ka amali istemal hain. Ubhar-khabar, kharab sarak par aaramdeh safar ke liye damping zaruri hai: is ke baghair gari har jhatke ke baad uchhalti rehti. Critical damping behtareen hai, kyunke gari ka dhancha jhoole baghair kam se kam waqt mein apni aam satah par wapas aa jata hai; halki damping mein yeh der tak uchhalti, aur bhari damping mein ahista wapas aati aur suspension agla jhatka jazb na kar pata.

blocks.alt: Gari ka pahiya (wheel) suspension ke baazuon aur shock absorber se jura hai; shock absorber ke gird coil spring lipta hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 14.16: Gari ka suspension nizam (kitab ki Figure 14.16 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.prompt: Gari ke suspension nizam mein critical damping kyun pasand ki jati hai?
blocks.explanation: Yeh gari ke dhanche ko jhoole baghair kam se kam waqt mein tawazun ki jagah par le aati hai, is liye safar hamwar hota aur suspension agle jhatke ke liye tayyar rehta hai.

items: Halki (jhoolta), critical (sab se jaldi wapsi, jhoolna nahi), bhari (ahista wapsi).
Gari ke shock absorbers: critical damping ke qareeb.
